name: AI-READI Survey Data Element Commons
description: Value-set mappings of AI-READI survey, vision care and cognitive assessment (MoCA) data elements to the OMOP Common Data Model, with SSSOM metadata, LinkML schema, AI-READI custom vocabularies, and scripts to reproduce the counts reported in the TVST 2026 manuscript.
releaseNotes: Concept map v1.3: line 127 qualifier 1615066 replaced with 2615313; cmtrt_lfst_1 Yes answer 607008 replaced with 45877994; four health history condition concepts corrected (neurological, urinary, high cholesterol, cancer); three health history question qualifiers aligned with their v1.1 Condition targets (cognitive impairment, hearing loss, cataract); two concept names aligned with the OMOP vocabulary. See CHANGELOG.md.
